baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a DC motor actuator. The product of CBP ruling N348465, as its facts describe it. The DC motor actuator is assembled in Canada using components sourced from China.

The DC motor, gearbox assembly, screw drive, housings, sensor printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) and electrical apparatus are produced in China. 

Final assembly in Canada: fasten the motor to the gearbox, insert the components and fasten with screws; solder the electrical apparatus and secure the wires to the motor actuator; test, lubricate and package.

Tariff classifications given with the product (HTSUS; the product's own codes, not verified by CBP): the DC motor actuator (the finished good), 8501; the DC motor (made in China), 8501; the gearbox assembly (made in China), 8483.40; the screw drive (made in China), 8483.40; the housings (made in China), 8503.00; the sensor printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) (made in China), 8503.00; the electrical apparatus (made in China), 8536.

key_factors: (b) essential character imparted by the Chinese DC motor
prediction.decisive_step: Production of the DC motor and failing components in China
prediction.reasoning: The 102.20 rule for heading 8501 requires a shift from any other heading, except from 8503. The Chinese DC motor (8501), housings (8503), and sensor PCBA (8503) fail the shift. Under 102.11(b)(1), the Chinese DC motor imparts the essential character.
